overview.description: The iShares U.S. Pharmaceuticals ETF (IHE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the DJ US Select / Pharmaceutical index. The fund tracks a broad-based, cap-weighted index of US pharmaceutical companies. IHE was launched on May 1, 2006 and is issued by BlackRock.
